summary.text: Kim Thatcher is a Republican member of the Oregon State Senate for District 11, which her legislative page associates with Keizer.
Her biography lists Senate committee service since 2015 and House committee service beginning in 2005.

paragraphs.text: Thatcher's biography lists membership on the Senate Workforce and Senate Judiciary committees since 2015 and on House committees including Business and Labor, Education and Judiciary between 2005 and 2015.
It also lists service on the Joint Committee on Ways and Means from 2011 to 2012 and co-chair of the Joint Legislative Committee on Audits, Information Management and Technology.
Professionally, she founded KT Contracting in 1992 and Highway Specialties in 1996 and co-founded the Oregon Contractors Association in 2003.
Her biography says she is a certified instrument-rated pilot, has four children and enjoys reading, playing piano and travel.
